The photo shows a single slice of bread on a square white plate. I can't see the whole plate, so I'm guessing it's a side plate of about 22 cm.

The slice measures roughly 540 px across in an image where the plate is about 1000+ px wide. That puts the slice at about 11–12 cm wide and about 11 cm tall. Sandwich bread slices are usually 1.5–2 cm thick, so I'm assuming a thickness of about 1.5 cm.

Its footprint is about 11 × 11 cm, minus the rounded corners, which gives roughly 110 cm². At 1.5 cm thick that is about 165 cm³. The crumb is airy, so I'm using a density of about 0.25 g/cm³, which gives roughly 41 g. A typical slice weighs 30–45 g, so I'll use 40 g.

The yellow color suggests an egg or brioche-style bread, or possibly a turmeric or corn bread. It looks lightly toasted. I'll use about 290 kcal per 100 g.
